MEASURED, NOT ASSUMED: both states produce the identical line, `exists but names
no findings (empty, unreadable or malformed)`. `_finding_ids` reads ids with a
REGEX and never parses the file, so a truncated ledger, a zero-byte one and a
correct `findings: []` are one state to it. That is DEFENSIBLE here -- all three
mean "this file cannot verify a citation", and answering UNVERIFIED to all three
is right -- but it is not free: a half-written ledger from an interrupted merge
is reported in exactly the wording of a deliberately empty one, and nothing tells
a reader which happened. Filed as SS-02-DF-01, routed to SS-05, NOT repaired
here.
collapsed.why: the two states declare the SAME expected output
